summary: Grayscale Sui Staking ETF filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 2 to its Trust Agreement, mandating quarterly (intended monthly) distributions of staking reward cash proceeds to shareholders. This is a routine fund governance amendment, not a special situation. No deal terms, prices, premiums, or strategic actions are involved. The filing only updates distribution mechanics and tax disclosure, with a prospectus supplement expected. No special-situation category applies; this is ordinary ETF operational reporting.
